name: Power 5 Extract By Foodsporen
description:
Power 5 Extract By Foodsporen | Maine chaga extract | Chaga extract powder

Power 5 Extract By Foodsporen

Shroom powder capsules. The Power 5 capsules from Foodsporen are a blend of the 5 most powerful mushrooms from the mushroom kingdom, specially composed for your health! If you want to experience the effects of these 5 powerhouses together or if you can’t choose between these 5 winners, (we get that) then the Power 5 mushroom complex is just right for you! Each vegetable capsule is richly filled for you with highly concentrated mushroom extract which are made from the fruiting bodies of our mushrooms. Our power 5 mushroom extract capsules contain no less than 30% polysaccharides!

Foodsporen only uses the fruiting bodies for each of its products. No fillers or mycelia grown on grains.  The Power 5 capsules have a high concentration ratio of no less than 8:1 – 8:1 – 12:1 – 12:1 – 12:1

Number of doses: | Buy Power 5 Extract By Foodsporen

60 capsules

Product information

Per capsule (400mg):

Lion’s Mane 8:1 (Hericium erinaceus) fruiting body extract 80mg

Turkey Tail 12:1 (Coriolus versicolor) fruiting body extract 80mg

Cordyceps 8:1 (Cordyceps militaris) fruiting body extract 80mg

Reishi 12:1 (Ganoderma lucidum) fruiting body extract 80mg

Chaga 12:1 (Inonotus obliquus) fruiting body extract 80mg

Usage:

1 capsule 1 or 2 times daily. Do not take with carbonated drinks or medicines.

Suitable for:

Vegetarians and vegans

Not suitable for:

During pregnancy, breastfeeding and/or an allergy to one of the ingredients. If in doubt, consult your doctor or pharmacist.

Foodsporen® Power 5 has been specially developed to supplement your daily diet with the healthy nutrients from the mushrooms mentioned, which are freely absorbable by the body.
